fusions.name: Shaken Dry
fusions.desc: Flings 3 beads of water from your scales, spread apart, each dealing 3 water damage, with a 35% chance per hit to leave the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skipped Flat
fusions.desc: Skips a flat scale at a target, dealing 12 water damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles, and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Moult It Off
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Oiled Lapping
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 12% water resistance.
